blocks.text: 11. Key Takeaways

items: ONNX is a format solving the cross-framework portability problem for trained models.
It exists specifically to break the tight coupling of framework-specific serialization formats.
ONNX represents a model as a standardized computation graph, independent of the original framework.
A model trained in one framework gets exported once into this shared ONNX format.
A separate ONNX runtime can load and run the exported model without the original training framework.
Not every operation every framework supports has a direct ONNX equivalent, a real limitation.
ONNX runtimes exist across many languages and platforms, letting one export run almost anywhere.
ONNX suits deploying across multiple platforms or frameworks; single-framework deployment needs it less.
